raw_request_summary: Fix SEC-002: enforce physical allowed-root containment for repository paths in github-push and gitlab MCP and for workspace/session paths in session-search MCP. Resolve symlinks before Git or session reads, retain safe repository creation and bounded historical-workspace handling, fail closed on invalid filesystem paths, and add isolated regression tests. Separate remediation from the accepted security baseline; no SEC-001 merge, remote host policy (SEC-005), dependency changes, live MCP deployment, push, release or merge.
